p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: Buyer handle everything from seller’s factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: The seller delivers the goods certified for shipment to the buyer.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: the seller loads the goods on the ship; after that, risk and cost are at the buyer’s expense.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: The seller pays the freight and insurance at the port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: The seller delivers to destination, the buyer pays the import duty.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: The seller pays everything, including import tax.
p.espaces.cu_ban: It is prohibited or controlled everywhere: weapons, drugs, fraud, protected species (CITES), some drugs. such a list is rejected and can be reported (ar).

Understanding the document
p.papier.sub: Take a picture of a letter, medicine, form or sign: read in your language.
p.papier.private: The picture remains on your phone. Only the text that was being read is sent to the free translation service.
p.papier.first: First time in this language: the phone downloads its data read (a few MB).
p.papier.none: No text found. Take a picture again, flat and more light.
p.papier.e_lib: Reading could not start: first time Internet required. Try again once to connect.
p.papier.e_read: Read failed. Take a picture again.
p.papier.e_tr: translation cannot be done (connection or daily limit). Try again.
p.papier.warn: Machine translation: for important documents (court, health, financial, residence permit), that are being looked at by someone you trust or party. Handwriting is often misread.
